Overview

Manaus is a city in AM with a population of 2,255,903. The Amazon’s largest city and economic hub, known for its rivers, rainforest access, and the iconic Teatro Amazonas opera house. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 85 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
